$comment: Source of truth for feature state. Mirrors the phases/slices in docs/PLAN.md. Status: not-started | in-progress | blocked | done. Only one feature in-progress at a time. 'done' requires evidence (command + result).

features.name: Phase 0 — Design prototype on mock data
features.description: PLAN.md Phase 0 steps 1–6: scaffold, domain core (test-first), Sky, primitives, all screens on mock data, copy deck.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — typecheck, lint, vitest 6 files / 44 tests passed, next build OK (7 static routes). Commits d5695fd..079a1d5.

features.name: Phase 0 gate — owner design review
features.description: Playwright screenshots of every screen × sky state at phone + desktop in Vietnamese and English (bun run review → review/vi/*.png; bun run review -- --lang=en → review/en/*.png) plus a morning-ritual recording. Owner approves or redirects.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: owner approved the Phase 0 design ("approved") after reviewing review/vi and review/en (31 shots per size, phone + desktop, no console errors; commit d393c53). The morning-ritual recording was not produced; the owner approved without it.

features.name: Slice 1 — Foundation
features.description: Clerk (restricted, passkey + Google), Neon + Drizzle schema with check constraints, user row on first sign-in, Vercel deploy + GitHub previews. Remove Phase 0 `instant = false` opt-out. Done when: owner signs in on a deployed URL; others cannot sign up. Evening-mode hour uses the user timezone, not the device clock.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh pass (97 Vitest tests incl. 13 schema-constraint tests on PGlite + ensureUser + ritualMode; next build OK). Migration applied to Neon (bun run db:migrate). Deployed 7178037 to https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app (Ready). Signed out, every route redirects to /sign-in (browser) or 404s (non-browser); no sign-up page; Clerk hosted sign-up refuses a non-allowlisted email ("…is not allowed to access this application."). Review (dev:review) vi + en: no console errors. 2026-11-05: owner signed in on https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app with Google; users row created in Neon (clerk_id user_3LfI…, timezone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh from x-vercel-ip-timezone, locale vi). Passkeys left to the owner in the Clerk dashboard (not required by the done-criterion). Deviation: instant = false kept until Slice 3 (PLAN records why).

features.name: Slice 2 — Tasks + Capture live
features.description: Create (kind required, last kind preselected), complete, edit, delete, filters; optimistic. Done when: phone capture is type + Enter; DB rejects a kind/link mismatch. Includes close (history) vs delete (mistakes only); due date set via edit, due/overdue shown on Today.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh pass (127 Vitest tests: tasks/plans data layer on PGlite incl. DB rejecting a kind/link mismatch, ownership, Top 3 cap, idempotent create, atomic plan switch; plan-switch + dueStatus domain). bun run review vi + en: no console errors; new shot 07b-task-sheet. Objectives + Plans + user-row Settings pulled forward (owner's choice). 2026-11-05: deployed (6c088c5, Ready); owner's account loaded it on production (three plan rows created in Neon). Owner accepted the slice and moved on before trying capture on the phone; that check happens in normal use. Smoothness pass after owner feedback (blur-free rows, light tab fade, loading placeholder).

features.name: Slice 3 — Morning ritual live
features.description: Compass line, Top 3 + carry-over, Intention → daily_logs. Done when: flow runs once per Logical Day; mock store deleted. Carry-over looks back to the most recent Top 3 day within 7 days; final Top 3 saved in daily_logs.top3TaskIds.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh pass (142 Vitest tests: carry-over domain; daily logs, logged Top 3 following every change and feeding carry-over, Compass, Decisions, Day 1 setup in one transaction and only once, onboarding state on PGlite). bun run review: no console errors; carry-over chip comes from the logged Top 3. Mock store gone from the signed-in app (store.tsx: all data from the server; sample data only in signed-out review). E2E (2026-11-05, signed in as the e2e test user, real Neon): `bun run e2e` (local prod build) 4/4 passed; `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bun run e2e` 4/4 passed twice. e2e/day-one.spec.ts proves: first run saves Compass/Objective/tasks/Top 3/morning in the DB and survives reload; next morning the ritual opens once with yesterday's unfinished Top 3 preselected (finished one not offered), intention + Top 3 land in daily_logs, reload skips the ritual. Also covers Slice 2: phone capture type + Enter with last why preselected, due today on Today, let go keeps the row, delete removes it.

features.name: Slice 4 — Evening check-in live
features.description: Sheet, close the day, Life Share bar, week dots. Done when: a check-in at 00:40 lands on the previous day. Next morning offers "Close yesterday?" once (ratings/sources/note, no task ticking); counts toward week dots.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: `bun run e2e` 7/7 locally (e2e/evening.spec.ts: check-in at 00:40 lands on the previous Logical Day — daily_logs row for D0 closed, none for D+1; missed yesterday offered once next morning, saves ratings/sources/note with no task ticking, week label then reads 2/7; skipped → never offered again, even when the ritual is opened by hand). Production (commit 36b896a, deploy 5kvdbi01l Ready): `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/day-one.spec.ts e2e/evening.spec.ts` → 7 passed (1.9m). ./init.sh green; Vitest 146.

features.name: Slice 5 — First run
features.description: Compass → Objective → tasks → "Which of these is for today?" (picks become Top 3; day 1 counts as morning done) under the implicit Current Path. Six one-time in-context tips (first Top 3, capture, Morning Ritual, evening, closed day, Life) + Settings "Show tips again". Odyssey nudges on Logical Day 2/4/6 (Not now = 2-day snooze, stops after 3). Reminder ask once after first closed day. One onboarding card at a time on Today (tip → reminder → nudge). State in users.onboarding jsonb. Prototyped on mock data first. Done when: a fresh account is usable in < 3 min.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: e2e/onboarding.spec.ts — Top 3 tip dismissed on one device is gone on a second browser context (no shared storage) and survives that device dismissing another tip; reminder ask after the first closed day, then Plan 1 nudge, Not now → snoozed two days, both gone on the second device; Show tips again brings tips back elsewhere. Fresh account usable in < 3 min: e2e/day-one.spec.ts first run (Compass → Objective → tasks → today's picks → Today with Top 3) completes in ~21–25 s including sign-in. Local `bun run e2e` 10/10; production (commit cbb6fc8) `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/onboarding.spec.ts` → 3 passed. Vitest 154.

features.name: Slice 6 — Life page live
features.description: Compass edit, Odyssey (gauges, set active + promotion sheet), Objectives, Decisions. Done when: promoting a plan with open Prototypes forces convert/close. Plan switch also settles old plan Objectives (Drop/Keep) and ends with a pre-filled Decision; max 3 active Objectives (reactivating or folding Prototypes into a new Objective respects the cap); Objective Done asks close/move open tasks.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: e2e/life.spec.ts — switching to a plan with an open Prototype: sheet requires Keep/Drop for the old plan's Objective (Keep preselected) and fold (named) or close for the Prototype — Confirm disabled with no name; Drop closes the old Objective's open tasks, Prototype becomes an Objective task under the new Objective; pre-filled Decision "Chuyển sang …" saved, linked to the plan. Server refuses an unsettled switch (resolution_required) and leaves the Active Plan unchanged. Objective Done → sheet (close default / move) → open tasks moved. Local `bun run e2e` 13/13; production (commit 895d887) `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/life.spec.ts` → 3 passed. Review shots review/vi/*-08b-promotion.png, *-08c-finish-objective.png. Vitest 167.

features.name: Slice 7 — Quarter Close card
features.description: Done when: Q4 leftovers on 1 Jan get Done / Drop / Carry forward. Non-blocking card; carry forward moves open tasks, drop closes them; old Objectives usable until settled; ends with Decision prompt and "add one?" if < 3.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: e2e/quarter-close.spec.ts — Q3 leftovers (seeded) in Q4: card on Today doesn't block (Top 3 visible), leftover still offered as a why in capture; Carry forward → old 'carried', copy active in this quarter with only the open task moved (done task stays); Drop → open task closed; Decision saved; "add one?" shows 2/3; reload → card gone. 1 January boundary in src/domain/quarter-close.test.ts (2027-Q1 vs 2026-Q4). Local `bun run e2e` 14/14; production (commit 3b56287, migration 0001 applied to Neon first) `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/quarter-close.spec.ts` → 1 passed. Vitest 176.

features.name: Slice 8 — Settings + Export
features.description: Times, timezone, day-ends-at, theme, JSON export. Done when: export round-trips every table.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: e2e/settings.spec.ts — reminder time, evening hour, day end, timezone, theme saved to the users row and shown after reload; Export all downloads JSON with every table (incl. a Daily Log from March, a decision, a written plan; no user id), then tasks/decisions deleted, file restored with importAll on Neon, re-export identical; signed out /api/export → 404 with no data. Vitest round trip on a fresh PGlite (src/data/export.test.ts). Local `bun run e2e` 17/17; production (commit 226e162) `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/settings.spec.ts` → 3 passed. Vitest 181.

features.name: Slice 9 — PWA + Reminder
features.description: Manifest, icons, SW cache of Today, install prompt, web push, QStash schedule per user (ADR 0001). Done when: push arrives at the chosen minute on the iPhone Home-Screen app. Offline capture keeps the draft (no background sync).
features.evidence: Partial, 2026-11-05: manifest + icons, service worker (Today offline, push handler), install prompt, push opt-in in Settings, /api/remind (QStash-signed only), per-user QStash schedule kept in step with time/zone, offline capture draft. e2e/pwa.spec.ts 3/3 locally; Vitest src/data/reminders.test.ts with fakes. Blocked: Upstash QStash + VAPID keys not provisioned (owner decision); done-criterion (push at the chosen minute on the owner's iPhone Home-Screen app) needs the owner's phone. Production (commit e6966f5): `E2E_BASE_URL=https://daily-happy-life.vercel.app bunx playwright test e2e/pwa.spec.ts` → 4 passed (manifest/icons, Chromium installability errors = [], Today offline, offline capture draft, /api/remind refuses unsigned). VAPID keys added to Vercel env (all environments) 2026-11-05. QStash: waiting on the owner accepting Upstash Marketplace terms.

features.name: Slice 10 — Finish
features.description: Perf budget, a11y audit in all sky states, Playwright ritual smoke test, polish. Done when: every budget in PLAN.md's design table is met.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05, production, Lighthouse mobile profile (150 ms RTT, 1.6 Mbps, CPU 4×), `bunx playwright test e2e/perf.spec.ts`: Today interactive (first tap on capture opens the sheet, hydration included) 1277 ms cold / 1152 ms repeat visit (budget 1500); INP slowest of 17 interactions 72 ms, most 16 ms = one frame (budget 100). A11y e2e/a11y.spec.ts 8/8: axe WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A+AA, no serious/critical issues on Today/Tasks/Life/Settings at dawn, day, dusk, night, forced light and dark, and in the morning ritual; every control offers a 44px target (fixed: mindset strip keyboard-scrollable; .hit areas, 44px icon buttons). Install: Chromium reports no installability errors on production. Ritual smoke test: `bun run smoke` (e2e/day-one.spec.ts). Full local `bun run e2e` 31/31. Open: clean install on iOS checked on the owner's iPhone, together with Slice 9's push.
